title: Rule 7: service, leave, resignation and technical-resignation gate

units.spoken_ref: Rule seven, subrule one.
units.explanation: Categories one और three: one year continuous Central service plus other conditions.
units.example: Ravi: ten months service; leave alone enough नहीं.

units.spoken_ref: Rule seven, subrule one, journey date.
units.explanation: Service gate actual self या family journey date पर check करो.
units.example: Family ten months पर गयी; later eligibility cure नहीं.

units.spoken_ref: Rule seven, subrule two; FAQ twenty five.
units.explanation: Casual और special casual leave allowed; leave properly approved हो.
units.example: Neha casual leave पर जाये; earned leave compulsory नहीं.

units.spoken_ref: Rule seven GID one, vacation paragraph.
units.explanation: Vacation department की vacation regular leave count होती है.
units.example: Teacher vacation पर जाये; office weekend अलग है.

units.spoken_ref: FAQ twenty seven; Rule seven Note two.
units.explanation: Self का weekend only trip बिना leave LTC नहीं.
units.example: Ravi Saturday Sunday घूमा, leave zero; claim assume नहीं.

units.spoken_ref: FAQ twenty six.
units.explanation: Family only journey पर employee को leave necessary नहीं.
units.example: Neha office में, eligible spouse hometown जाये.

units.spoken_ref: Rule seven, subrule two; CCL instruction.
units.explanation: CCL valid leave है, extra LTC occasion नहीं.
units.example: Three CCL spells से three bonus trips नहीं.

units.spoken_ref: Rule seven GID two.
units.explanation: Regular leave के बाद resign, duty return नहीं: concession inadmissible.
units.example: Ravi trip के बाद job छोड़ दे; normal claim fail.

units.spoken_ref: Twenty twenty two order, two point one point one.
units.explanation: Proper channel selection और administrative resignation qualify, label alone नहीं.
units.example: Letter में technical word नहीं; qualifying facts matter.

units.spoken_ref: Rule seven GID eight, one.

units.spoken_ref: Rule seven GID eight, two A.
